       and 2 (ADAMS Accession No. ML 26041A223).

By the letter dated December 31, 2025 (ML26009A012), SMR, LLC a Holtec International
Company, submitted the first part of a phased construction permit application to the U.S.
Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) for the proposed dual-unit SMR-300 facility at the
Palisades Energy Center (PEC) in Covery, Michigan. The application included a request
for a limited work authorization (LWA) pursuant to Title 10 of Code of Federal Regulations
(10 CFR) 50.10, “License required; limited work authorization.” The proposed units are
designated as Pioneer Unit 1 and Pioneer Unit 2.
The purpose of this letter is to provide responses to NRC audit questions and associated
changes to the “Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Limited Work Authorization Application” as a result
of those responses.
Enclosure 1 contains the proprietary version of the NRC audit questions and Holtec
responses, and associated markups to the LWA R0. Enclosure 2 contains the
corresponding non-proprietary version of Enclosure 1.
SMR, LLC requests that Enclosure 1 be withheld from public disclosure in accordance
with 10 CFR 2.390. An Affidavit is also included with this letter as Enclosure 3.
If you have any questions or require any additional information, please contact Jacob
Dolekci, Senior Manager – Licensing & Engineering Programs, SMR, at
jdolecki@holtec.com, 856-559-3783.
